title: termal_followup_session to a reviewer keeps the child's original cwd; a follow-up naming a different worktree silently reviews the old root
outcome: A follow-up to a delegation whose next input lives in a different worktree either moves the child to that worktree explicitly, with an approved cwd argument and the read-only policy applied to the new root, or is refused up front with a named reason. A reviewer never reviews a different tree than the one its prompt names.
acceptance: termal_followup_session to a reviewer keeps the child's original cwd; a follow-up naming a different worktree silently reviews the old root is done
